# Native Minidump fixtures

`amd64-minidump.dmp` is an 1,810-byte synthetic Minidump generated by the test harness, not captured from a user or external crash. It contains one AMD64 thread, one `test_app.pdb` module, an access-violation exception and a two-frame stack. The server integration test pairs it with a synthetic textual Breakpad `.sym` file to verify native ingestion and source-line symbolication.
